justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief compositions organised into vertically stacked panels with a border running along the edge, and both include humanoid figures amid dense filling ornament. Beyond that the content diverges sharply: A shows a small ship with sail and crew above symmetrical interlaced serpentine knotwork, while B shows a single large frontal figure with an elaborate feathered headdress, pectoral and held implements above a block of sign-like glyph cartouches — no shared specific motif, posture or attribute.
